title: Reverse Words in a String III
summary: Given a string s, reverse the characters in each word while maintaining the original order of words and spaces.
statement: Given a string s, reverse the characters in each word while maintaining the original order of words and spaces.
constraints: 1 <= len(s) <= 50,000; printable ASCII; words are separated by one space with no leading/trailing spaces.
Reverse characters inside each word while preserving word order and spaces.
reference_solution:
def reverse_each_word(s):
    return ' '.join(word[::-1] for word in s.split(' '))
hints: Word positions are fixed; only each word reverses.
Split at the known single spaces and reverse each piece.
Map reversal over words and join with one space.
Every character remains in its original word, so no global reversal or word-order change is allowed.
editorial: Every character remains in its original word, so no global reversal or word-order change is allowed.

tests.explanation: Reverse each word separately: s'teL ekat edoCteeL tsetnoc.
The two word positions stay Mr, Ding; their characters become rM, gniD.
